CMOS enable-controlled ring oscillator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VEN en 0 PWL(0 0 20n 0 20.1n 3.3 160n 3.3 160.1n 0 220n 0 220.1n 3.3 380n 3.3 380.1n 0 420n 0)
XDUT vdd 0 en out astra_024_cmos_gated_ring_oscillator
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec disabled_start range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec high range 3.1 3.4 unit=V
* @spec low range -0.1 0.2 unit=V
* @spec period range 1e-9 2e-8 unit=s
* @spec disabled_stop range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec restart_high range 3.1 3.4 unit=V
* @spec restart_low range -0.1 0.2 unit=V
* @spec final_stop range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 5p 420n
meas tran disabled_start FIND v(out) AT=15n
meas tran high MAX v(out) FROM=40n TO=140n
meas tran low MIN v(out) FROM=40n TO=140n
meas tran period TRIG v(out) VAL=1.65 RISE=5 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 RISE=6
meas tran disabled_stop MIN v(out) FROM=190n TO=215n
meas tran restart_high MAX v(out) FROM=240n TO=360n
meas tran restart_low MIN v(out) FROM=240n TO=360n
meas tran final_stop MIN v(out) FROM=400n TO=420n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
